import json
with open('/root/.nanobot/agents/lucas/config.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)
print('✅ Valid JSON')
print(f'agents.defaults.model = {d[\"agents\"][\"defaults\"][\"model\"]}')
print(f'agents.defaults.temperature = {d[\"agents\"][\"defaults\"][\"temperature\"]}')
print(f'agents.defaults.maxToolIterations = {d[\"agents\"][\"defaults\"][\"maxToolIterations\"]}')
print(f'hyperparams = {json.dumps(d[\"hyperparams\"], indent=2)}')
print(f'rank = {d[\"rank\"]}')
print(f'gateway.port = {d[\"gateway\"][\"port\"]}')
print(f'model = {d[\"model\"]}')
print(f'tools.exec = {d[\"tools\"][\"exec\"]}')
print(f'tools.web_search = {d[\"tools\"][\"web_search\"]}')
# Verify NO array-wrapped values remain
def check_no_arrays(obj, path=''):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k,v in obj.items():
            check_no_arrays(v, f'{path}.{k}')
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for i,v in enumerate(obj):
            check_no_arrays(v, f'{path}[{i}]')
    elif isinstance(obj, str):
        if obj.startswith('${') and obj.endswith('}'):
            pass  # env var refs are fine
check_no_arrays(d)
print('✅ No array-wrapped values detected')
"
